boundary.description: From the point where Featherstall Road South crosses the railway, S along Featherstall Road South, Manchester Street, Frederick Street, Hollins Road to M60 Motorway, junction 22. Then NW along the Motorway to junction 21 and then N by the Rochdale Canal to the point opposite the junction of Moston Road and Grimshaw lane, and by a beeline E to the point where the railway crosses Featherstall Road South.
